description: Source code for a Frappe/ERPNext module handling import of supplier invoices from XML files, including parsing, creating suppliers, addresses, purchase invoices, and related utilities.

classes.name: ImportSupplierInvoice
classes.description: Main class handling import of supplier invoices from XML files, including validation, data import, and processing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates stock UOM setting before import.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Automatically generates a name for the import record based on creation date.

methods.name: import_xml_data
methods.description: Main method to process the ZIP file containing XML invoices, parse each file, and create purchase invoices.

methods.name: prepare_data_for_import
methods.description: Prepares invoice data from XML content, including supplier, address, taxes, and items.

methods.name: prepare_items_for_invoice
methods.description: Extracts item details from XML and appends to invoice items.

methods.name: process_file_data
methods.description: Enqueues the import process for background execution.
